common.name: Name
common.readOnly: Your role can only view this page.
common.showOnceHelp: This value is shown once. Copy it now and store it safely.

nav.notFoundHelp: This address does not exist, or you cannot view it.
nav.noTenant: You are not a member of any tenant
nav.noTenantHelp: Ask a team owner to add you, or register again to create a new tenant.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.help: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

acceptInvite.title: Join the team
acceptInvite.help: You were invited to a MiniLoyal dashboard. New here? Set a password to create your account. Already have an account with this email? Sign in first, then open the link again.
acceptInvite.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Only needed when you are creating a new account.
acceptInvite.missingToken: This invitation link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
acceptInvite.signInRequired: This email already has an account. Sign in with it, then open the invitation link again to join the team.

apps.title: Apps
apps.help: One app is one LINE MINI App.
apps.name: Name
apps.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens for URLs. Leave empty to derive it from the name.

team.title: Team
team.help: People who can sign in to this dashboard. Invite them by email; the link creates their account when they have none.
team.inviteLinkHelp: Send this link to {{email}}. It works once and expires in 7 days.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.help: Every dashboard and staff action, newest first.

settings.title: App settings
settings.name: Name
settings.oaHelp: The brand's Messaging API channel. The Official Account and the MINI App channel must belong to the same provider, or user IDs will not match.
settings.oaSecretHint: Updated only when you type one; after saving, only whether it is set is shown.
settings.notVerifiedHint: Save the channel ID and secret: MiniLoyal verifies them with LINE and fills in the basic ID.
settings.webhookHelp: LINE sends follow and unfollow events here so friend status stays current.
settings.webhookStep1: Open the Messaging API channel in the LINE Developers Console.
settings.webhookStep2: Paste this URL into Webhook URL under the Messaging API settings and click Verify.

security.title: Security
security.hs256Help: Only needed for LINE web login. LINE MINI Apps and LIFF use ES256 tokens, so leave this off unless a web login flow signs members in.
security.signOutHelp: Every member session issued before now stops working. Members sign in again through LINE automatically the next time they open the MINI App.
security.signOutBody: All members of this app are signed out. Type {{phrase}} to confirm.
security.neverSignedOut: Members have never been signed out all at once.

channels.title: LINE MINI App channels
channels.help: A MINI App channel has three internal channels (developing, review, published), each with its own LIFF ID. Fill them in separately; every configured channel ID is accepted as the member ID token audience. The staff app signs in through its own LINE Login channel, configured in the fourth row.
channels.secretHint: Required. MiniLoyal verifies the channel with it; only whether it is set is shown afterwards.
channels.removeConfirm: Remove the channel settings for the {{environment}} environment?
channels.staffHelp: Create a separate LINE Login channel under the same provider for the staff app and add its LIFF app here. Staff sign-in accepts only this channel and member sign-in never does, so a member token from the MINI App can never open the staff app. Its channel ID must differ from the MINI App channel.

stores.title: Stores
stores.help: The locations where staff add points, stamps and redeem coupons.
stores.name: Store name
stores.deleteConfirm: Delete the store "{{name}}"? It cannot be deleted while staff are assigned.

staff.title: Staff
staff.help: Staff sign in to the staff app with LINE and enter their invite code on first sign-in.
staff.inviteHelp: Give this code to the staff member to enter in the staff app on first sign-in.
staff.resetConfirmBody: "{{name}}" is signed out of the staff app and their LINE account is unlinked. They sign in again with the new code.
staff.resetInviteHelp: Give this 12-character code to the staff member. In the staff app, they sign in with LINE and enter the code once; it expires in 7 days.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.help: Server keys for brand backends and POS systems. A key is shown only once, when created.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key "{{name}}"? Systems using it lose access immediately.
apiKeys.keyHelp: Send this key in the X-API-Key header.

password.title: Change password
password.hint: At least 10 characters. Other devices are signed out after the change.

totp.title: Two-step verification (TOTP)
totp.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the secret by hand:
totp.confirmCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
totp.recoveryHelp: Each code works once. Print them or keep them in a password manager; they cannot be shown again.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.logoutAllHelp: Ends the session on every device, including this one.

security.title: Security activity
security.help: Sign-ins and account changes, newest first.

members.title: Members
members.help: Everyone who signed in to this MINI App with LINE.

detail.privacyHelp: Export or erase this member's personal data for a PDPA request. Both actions are recorded in the audit log.
detail.eraseBody: Profile, contact details and consent are blanked and the member is signed out. Points and coupon history stay. Type {{phrase}} to confirm.

card.title: Member card
card.help: If the member lost their phone or shared their card, reset it. Every QR code the member's phone ever showed stops working; their phone shows a new one the next time it refreshes.
card.confirmBody: Every QR code this member's card showed stops working at once. Continue?
card.done: Card reset. Old QR codes no longer work (key version {{version}}).

points.title: Points
points.help: How members earn points when they buy something. Changes apply to points earned from now on.
points.spendPerPointHint: The amount a member spends to earn the points below.
points.minSpendHint: Purchases below this earn nothing. 0 means no minimum.
points.expiryDaysHint: Leave empty to keep points forever.

adjust.title: Adjust points
adjust.help: Add points with a positive number or remove them with a negative one. The change is recorded in the history and the audit log.
adjust.negativeWarning: This would take the balance below zero.
adjust.insufficient: The member does not have enough points for this change.
adjust.invalidDelta: Enter a whole number other than zero.

coupons.title: Coupon templates
coupons.help: Templates members claim or the brand issues. Archive a template to stop new claims; coupons already issued stay valid.
coupons.name: Name
coupons.totalLimitHint: Most coupons ever issued; leave empty for no limit. Already issued: {{n}}.
coupons.validityDaysHint: Leave empty for no relative expiry.
coupons.claimableHint: Turn off for reward and issue-only templates.
coupons.lockedHint: Type and value are fixed once a coupon has been issued from this template.

errors.amountValue: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
errors.percentValue: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
errors.totalLimit: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10,000,000, or leave empty.
errors.perMemberLimit: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
errors.perMemberAboveTotal: The per member limit cannot be above the total limit.
errors.validityDays: Enter a whole number from 1 to 3650, or leave empty.
errors.date: Enter a valid date and time.
errors.windowOrder: The end must be after the start.
errors.inUse: Coupons were already issued from this template, so its type and value can no longer change.

stampCards.title: Stamp cards
stampCards.help: Members collect stamps at the counter. Completing a card issues the reward coupon.
stampCards.name: Name
stampCards.stampsRequiredHint: From 2 to 100. Fixed once any member has a stamp on the card.
stampCards.rewardHint: An active template, usually an issue-only one.
stampCards.maxPerVisitHint: Staff can give at most this many on one scan.
stampCards.inUseHint: Locked: members already have stamps on this card.

errors.stampsRequired: Enter a whole number from 2 to 100.
errors.maxPerVisit: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
errors.inUse: Members already have stamps on this card, so the number of stamps cannot change. Your other changes were not saved yet.

memberCoupons.title: Coupons
memberCoupons.issueHelp: The member gets a coupon from an active template, whatever its claimable setting.
memberCoupons.voidHelp: Coupon {{code}} can no longer be redeemed. This does not give the template limit back.

errors.soldOut: This template has reached its total limit.
errors.notClaimable: This template is archived or outside its validity window.
errors.unavailable: This coupon was already redeemed or voided.

memberStamps.title: Stamp cards
memberStamps.empty: There are no stamp cards for this member yet.
memberStamps.adjustHelp: A positive change adds stamps and can complete the card; a negative one removes stamps. The change is recorded as a new entry.
memberStamps.unrewardedHint: The reward was unavailable (sold out or archived) when the card was completed. You can issue a coupon by hand from the Coupons tab.
memberStamps.doneUnavailable: Stamps adjusted, but {{n}} reward coupon could not be issued because the reward is unavailable. Issue one by hand from the Coupons tab.
memberStamps.deltaHint: A whole number from -100 to 100, not zero.
memberStamps.invalidDelta: Enter a whole number other than zero, up to 100.
memberStamps.insufficient: The member does not have that many stamps to remove.
